purpose: Vehicle-scoped drive history with measured efficiency, prior-period comparisons, trend analysis, FSD enrichment and actionable drive evidence.
primaryGoal: Find and inspect real drives in the workspace range, compare exceptions and export the selected vehicle's full date window.

dataSources.behavior: Selected vehicle; padded current/prior calendar window; bounded request; retained rows and source-local retry. Raw Drive SI fields remain in cache; conversions happen in presentation.
Vehicle/timezone and exclusive calendar instants; disabled beyond 366 days; independent errors, refresh and per-drive confidence.
Live-mode mutation; confirmed selected IDs; clears selection after successful deletion. Not invoked.
Server export excludes list filters and selection; scope description is explicit. Actual backend completeness not exercised.
Feature-gated opt-in prompt stream; ordinary typed search stays present. POST body contains prompt only. Route mount, workspace scoping, feature gate and result behavior remain unverified.

components.role: Sticky scope, six contextual brief metrics, six overview metrics with independent prior-period comparisons.

components.role: DateGroupedList, HistoryListRow, metrics, FSD/anomaly badges, selection and preview below 1024px.

components.role: Typed search, density, exports, mobile collection/FSD controls and confirmed bulk actions.

components.role: DataStateNotice, StaleRefreshWarning, QueryError, EmptyState, Skeleton, FadeIn, StaggerContainer and PullToRefresh; no replacement system needed.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Brief and overview deliberately repeat count/distance/efficiency in different contextual roles. This is not permission to remove either or create another KPI renderer.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain both roles; reuse existing OperationalBrief and stats formatting contracts when aligning presentation.

responsive.sourceStrategy: useMediaQuery('(min-width: 1024px)') switches table to date-grouped cards. Mobile toolbar and collection/FSD pills remain available. Analysis uses existing CardGrid; page uses min-w-0 and full-width container composition.

issues.detail: Numeric and endpoint grid predicates apply only when desktopEvidence is true; resizing below 1024px changes results while the persisted grid_* URL values remain. Mobile clear-all chips only clear q/coll/fsd. Value selections do have an explicit mobile notice and clear action.
issues.fix: Expose active numeric/endpoint filters in mobile UI and preserve their predicates across widths, or explicitly communicate a deliberate scope change. Do not silently alter source results.

issues.detail: Cards show average/max speed, battery, efficiency and estimated cost; desktop grid exposes specialist temperature/power/regen/score fields not present in the six-field preview. Detail navigation exists, but mobile equivalence and table preference access are not proven.
issues.fix: Preserve specialist fields and table actions through existing detail/preview or accessible card disclosure; validate the 640-1023 branch and desktop-to-mobile saved state rather than deleting metadata.

responsive.requiredQA: 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560px, allocated container width, long routes and translated labels, table scrolling, drawer scroll and sticky summary overlap.

sourceStrengths: Drive evidence section has localized aria-label; numeric filters have localized minimum/unit names.
Card checkboxes identify the drive date; grade badges have readable labels; meaningful warnings expose text alternatives.
Native detail Links preserve navigation semantics; drawer and focus behavior are delegated to existing shared owners.
Highlights retain dl/dt/dd semantics; page header retains a programmatic route-focus target.

issues.detail: Page passes query for freshness but no loading/busy/error props. PageContainer's load announcement and aria-busy use those explicit props, not query. Section skeletons preserve content, but a page-level loading announcement is not connected by this call site.
issues.fix: Wire non-replacing busy/announcement state through the existing PageContainer contract while retaining independent FSD/drive source recovery. Verify source-local announcements before adding duplicates.

accessibility.requiredQA: Keyboard sequence, visible focus, preview trap/restore/Escape, filter popovers, confirmed delete, screen-reader result/loading announcements, 44px touch reachability, effective contrast, forced colors and reduced motion.

states.loading: Independent initial drive loading with brief source wrapper, overview loading, chart/highlight skeletons and five evidence skeleton rows.
states.empty: Overview and highlights have local empty states; evidence reset/guidance present; no-vehicle path retains NoVehicleSelected.
states.error: Fatal drive errors retry locally in overview/analysis/evidence. FSD errors have their own notice/retry and do not erase drive history.
states.staleOffline: useDataState and StaleRefreshWarning retain payload and separate refresh errors; actual stale/offline presentation not exercised.
states.partialUnknown: Missing energy coverage notice, measured-only efficiency, absent per-drive FSD notice, unsupported >366-day FSD window and truncation warning remain.

issues.detail: Reset filters clears q/coll/fsd/grid_values and workspace from/to but leaves grid_distance/grid_grade and other numeric/endpoint filters. Empty copy distinguishes only collection/FSD/value selections, not search or numeric filters; a filtered-out result can be labeled 'No drives recorded yet'.
issues.fix: Differentiate selected-range empty from search/filter empty; clear the complete relevant page-filter set without resetting header-owned date scope unless explicitly labeled. Keep helpful guidance only when genuinely unfiltered.

visualIssues.detail: Grade B uses saturated neon cyan #00f0ff in the shared Grade.color palette. Sticky summary applies avgGrade.color directly to text at DrivesStickySummary.tsx:31; mobile efficiency text applies score.color at DriveCard.tsx:160. This bypasses theme-aware semantic foregrounds; composed contrast is unverified.
visualIssues.fix: Have the shared grade presentation map supply semantic, theme-aware text tones; preserve grade labels/numeric thresholds and domain calculations. Adapt both consumers together, not by introducing another palette.

visualIssues.detail: Five chart metrics provide local cyan/green/purple/amber/red hex colors. Existing chartTokens.series already owns the palette. Source saturation is confirmed; rendered noise/contrast is not. Data-series semantic color must not be indiscriminately removed.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse the accepted shared chart palette while retaining all five metrics, chosen metric, axes, values, missing behavior and saved chart preferences.

visualIssues.detail: Estimated-cost body text uses fixed text-emerald-300 without a light-theme counterpart; effective contrast is unverified.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing theme-aware semantic foreground tokens without changing cost approximation or configured-rate behavior.

architectureIssues.detail: Controller reads only start/end day keys from useRangeState, derives padded day fetch bounds and reconstructs FSD calendar instants. It does not consume the hook's precise startInstant/endInstantExclusive rolling bounds (useRangeState.ts:656-662); list filtering also compares local day keys. A 24h/Live header scope therefore loses precise instant semantics.
architectureIssues.fix: Integrate exact workspace instants into reads, exports and current-window aggregation while retaining intentional prior-period fetching, vehicle timezone, calendar/DST semantics and source-local trust. Backend instant filtering support must be verified, not assumed.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature imports Badge/Checkbox/InlineMetric through concrete shared paths. Analysis layout also imports Section/CardGrid directly from layout-reference despite canonical category barrels.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing ui/data-display/layout category barrels for feature consumers; do not replace the previous extracted source migration or shared internal concrete-import policy.

order: Exact rolling scope and reset semantics
Responsive filter continuity and mobile evidence access
priority.reason: Preserve the existing source migration. Correct scope/data trust risks before cosmetic adoption.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Theme-aware grade presentation mapping
requiredSharedChanges.detail: Existing domain palette couples numeric grade calculation to saturated raw foreground color.
requiredSharedChanges.fix: Coordinate a shared semantic presentation mapping; preserve existing Grade labels, numeric weights, thresholds and caller behavior.
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: A+/A success, B info, C warning, D danger, unknown neutral; text foregrounds must follow theme and forced-color modes. Do not change the numeric/label contract.
dependsOn: Existing semantic tokens in web\src\lib\tokens.ts; shared-owner contract acceptance and focused contrast tests

competingImplementations.detail: Local trend colors duplicate an existing chart palette owner at web\src\lib\tokens.ts:383-401.
competingImplementations.fix: Adopt the existing palette; do not create another chart/stats/layout system.

preservation.baselineComparison: Current source snapshot only; no Git/history or original monolith comparison performed.
actions: Pull-to-refresh both supported sources with cross-tab invalidation
Select drives and compare exactly two
dataBehavior: Keep raw SI and current query keys/policies/cancellation
Keep measured-energy coverage and unknown distinct from zero
Keep independent FSD payload and confidence/reset metadata
Keep prior-period comparisons separate from current window
Keep server export scope separate from list filters/selection
Keep truncation notice and all existing route/metadata/column capabilities
Keep workspace selection, locale, display units, timezone and URL/saved-view preferences

evidenceLimits.method: Read-only page/dependency inspection and bounded source-pattern checks; no browser, production actions, Git, source edits or nested delegation.
evidenceLimits.typescriptTestsBuild: Not run: Phase 0 prohibits full-repository validation. Skill script inspected but not executed because it always runs full web TypeScript.
evidenceLimits.sourcePatternScope: Page, drives-orchestrator TSX files, DriveCard, DrivesEvidenceTable and DrivesAnalysisSection only. Dynamic inline colors are palette issues, not static-style violations. No neon/glow/pure-white class matches in this bounded set; hex palette findings remain.
evidenceLimits.validationCaveat: Initial PowerShell raw-control regex was case-insensitive and counted shared Button/Input/Select tags. Reran with Select-String -CaseSensitive; corrected count is zero. Counts are bounded source evidence, not runtime acceptance.
unknowns: AI route mount and backend scope
